name: MidCaelum
tagline: Calculate, explore and print astrological charts on your Mac, with editable symbolic interpretations.
description:
MidCaelum is a native Mac application for astrological calculation and symbolic chart exploration. It combines chart drawing with an editable interpretation library.

## Features

- Tropical and sidereal charts with seven house systems, including Whole Sign.
- Built-in atlas with more than 200,000 locations.
- Current transits, solar and lunar returns, and secondary progressions.
- Chart comparison, customizable display and printing.
- Interface and built-in interpretations in six languages, selected through the macOS language.

## Where it fits

For people studying astrological symbolism who want a local desktop workflow. Interpretations are symbolic, not guaranteed predictions or decision-making recommendations. Unregistered use limits chart dates to the year 2000 UTC and excludes solar returns.

## Privacy and requirements

Requires macOS 12.6 or later. According to PasHart Software, calculations and built-in texts work offline, saved charts remain local, and no online account is required. Optional online actions are user-initiated. Export for AI copies text to the clipboard; sending it to an external service is the user's choice. Purchase and activation use an email address and license key.

## Pricing

A personal license costs EUR 39 as a one-time purchase, with no subscription. A limited free trial is available.
pricingDetails: EUR 39 one-time purchase. Free trial limited to chart dates in the year 2000 UTC; solar returns require a license. No subscription.
